steps: Join products and category_translation to get English category names.
Calculate the average product weight in grams (product_weight_g) grouped by English product category.
Order the categories by average weight descending and select the top 5.

args.purpose: Find top 5 product categories by average product weight in grams
args.sql:
SELECT 
    coalesce(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
    avg(p.product_weight_g) AS avg_weight_g,
    count(*) AS product_count
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5
